lava-bird.title: Play Lava Bird Online - Fiery Flight Adventure Game
lava-bird.slogan: Test your reflexes in this scorching side-scroller!
lava-bird.description: Embark on a fiery flight with Lava Bird! Navigate through a burning lava cave, dodge obstacles, and defeat enemies with destructive fireballs. With two exciting game modes, you can either go solo or challenge a friend. Experience the thrill of this action-packed 2D side-scroller. Play Lava Bird now and conquer the lava skies!

HomeIframe.title: Lava Bird - Fiery Flight Adventure
HomeIframe.description: Join Lava Bird in a fiery flight through the lava cave. Dodge obstacles, shoot fireballs, and defeat enemies in this thrilling 2D side-scroller. Play now!

HomeFeatures.whatIsDescription: Lava Bird is an action-packed 2D side-scroller where you control a fiery bird navigating through a dangerous lava cave. Avoid obstacles, shoot fireballs, and defeat enemies to become the king of the lava skies!
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep1: Use the spacebar or click to control the bird in single-player mode.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep2: In two-player mode, Player 1 (red bird) uses the W key, and Player 2 (blue bird) uses the up arrow keys.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep3: Avoid obstacles and defeat enemies to score points. The first player to reach five points wins!
HomeFeatures.feature1Description: Navigate through a dangerous lava cave filled with obstacles and enemies.
HomeFeatures.feature2Description: Shoot fireballs to destroy enemies and clear your path.
HomeFeatures.feature3Description: Choose between solo play or intense hand-to-hand combat with a friend.
HomeFeatures.feature4Description: Simple and intuitive controls make it easy for all players to enjoy.
